This chi is negative exactly for X1=1 or 2 and X2=0, with value -1; its mean is zero. The central convolution idempotent has endpoint 1/infinity norm degree times mean |chi| (attained by kernel signs), and permuting the remaining n-1 or n-2 non-short-cycle letters produces precisely the asserted coefficient. The exponential cycle index e^(-z-z^2/2)/(1-z) proves limit 3 e^(-3/2)/2. Independently enumerated all permutations for n=4..8: 4/3,25/6,117/20,406/45,850/63. No claim about intermediate p.
